QueryView.description: A snapshot of a Filter State applied to a Query by a User. Immutable: changing the filters creates a new Query View.

id.description: The ID of this Query View

user_id.description: The ID of the User that owns this Query View

pk.description: The PK of the Query this Query View applies to

time_created.description: The time this Query View was created

time_updated.description: The last time this Query View was created again or trashed or restored

time_deleted.description: When this Query View was soft deleted, or null if active

CreateQueryViewRequest.description: A new Query View, given either the ID of an existing Filter State owned by the User, or a version and state that is saved as a hidden Filter State (or resolves to the existing Filter State with the same version and state). The request body is limited to 64 KiB. A User has at most one active Query View per Query and Filter State: creating one that already exists returns the existing Query View with its time_updated bumped.

filter_state_id.description: The ID of a Filter State owned by the current User

version.description: The client defined version of the state format

state.description: Opaque client defined filter state. Any JSON value
